name: star-rating
title: Star Rating
description: Stars you tap or drag across; the fill sweeps from star to star and each one swells as it fills.

perf.budget: One small Skia canvas for all the stars, driven by two shared values. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The stars fill at once, without the sweep or the swell.
a11y.screenReader: An adjustable value ("3 of 5 stars") with increment and decrement actions; read-only ratings are a single image with the value in its name.
a11y.touchTarget: The row of stars is the target and at least 44 pt tall; each star is as wide as `size` plus the gap.
